purpose: Bound current-production versus normal-rate pronunciation/prosody candidates; fix a source hedge without inventing listening approval.
selection_policy: Measured original-window fit first; ASR is a diagnostic, not a pronunciation, emotion, or human-listening verdict. Prosody-only candidates remain unadopted without listening.

display_corrections.before: 最后总结一下。这里的图像是自由女神，我也想让大家从并发编程那些无意招来的、不必要的麻烦里，解放出来。倒是很应景。
display_corrections.after: 最后总结一下。图里的形象看着像自由女神，我也想让大家从并发编程那些无意招来的、不必要的麻烦里，解放出来。倒是很应景。
display_corrections.source_phrase: It looks like we're Lady Liberty
display_corrections.reason: Restore the original comparison rather than assert that the illustrated character is literally the Statue of Liberty; retain the liberation wordplay.

samples.before_spoken: 中间可以看到一颗 Intel 80386 C P U。再强调一下，它是 80386，速度并不快，而且缺少一些指令。

candidates.label: explicit-digits
candidates.text: 中间可以看到一颗英特尔八零三八六 C P U。再强调一下，它是八零三八六，速度并不快，而且缺少一些指令。
candidates.reason: Make the processor designation's digit sequence explicit, retain both occurrences and all performance/instruction qualifications.

candidates.label: compact-explicit-digits
candidates.text: 中间是英特尔八零三八六处理器。注意，是八零三八六；速度不算快，还缺一些指令。
candidates.reason: Equivalent concise alternative if the longer explicit spelling does not fit normally; CPU is rendered as processor, not omitted.

samples.before_spoken: 哎呀，刚按了什么？不太妙。好了，回来了。我得小心点。

candidates.label: connected-self-correction
candidates.text: 哎呀，刚按了什么？不太妙……好了，回来了，我得小心点。
candidates.reason: Compare connected self-correction without deleting any words; a changed pause detector result alone cannot approve this rendition.

candidates.label: connected-filler
candidates.reason: Only join the final complete acknowledgment with a comma; preserve both original all-right fillers, no automatic short-tail dismissal.

samples.before_spoken: 好。找到了。怪我刚才看的是幻灯片页码，而不是 PDF 页码，因为有些幻灯片被我跳过去了。

candidates.label: spaced-pdf
candidates.text: 好。找到了。怪我刚才看的是幻灯片页码，而不是 P D F 页码，因为有些幻灯片被我跳过去了。
candidates.reason: Isolate letter spelling as the only change; do not simultaneously alter opening prosody or page-number contrast.
